newsitem.title: USA: Frontier Insurance files for 4 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Frontier Insurance files for 4 mln shares.

text.p: Frontier Insurance Group Inc filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to four million common shares.
The Rock Hill, N.Y., insurance holding company said proceeds from the sale will be used tp repay about $62 million in bank debt and the balance will be used for general corporate purposes.

Underwriters for the offering, Merrill Lynch & Co, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Smith Barney Inc and Stephens Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 600,000 shares.
After the offering, the company will have 33,471,924 shares outstanding.
